task.requested_outcome: Enforce the vendor's published per-key rate limit in the request path, keep the regression suite passing, and ship a reproducible container image.
task.intended_user: release engineer deciding whether to deploy the change

conflicts.description: The suite is run against the worktree toolchain while the image is built from a pinned one; the brief does not say which toolchain the release is accepted on.

criteria.requirement: The regression suite passes against this exact revision
criteria.acceptance_rule: A regression suite runs against this revision in an isolated worktree and reports no failures.
criteria.expected_evidence: A command locator with cwd, exit status, and a log reference bound to the revision.

criteria.requirement: The enforced rate limit matches the vendor's published limit
criteria.acceptance_rule: The limit the change enforces equals the limit stated by the vendor's published documentation at a named version.
criteria.expected_evidence: A passage locator naming the source and its date, and the line that enforces the limit.

criteria.requirement: Throughput stays at or above the stated target
criteria.applicability: when a benchmark workload is supplied
criteria.acceptance_rule: Measured throughput on the stated workload is at or above 500 requests per second.
criteria.expected_evidence: A dimension entry with a measured value, its unit, and the tool that produced it.

criteria.requirement: The container image builds reproducibly from the revision
criteria.acceptance_rule: Two builds of this revision produce the same image digest.
criteria.expected_evidence: Command locators for both builds and the digests they printed.

criteria.requirement: Vendored third-party sources carry their upstream license headers
criteria.applicability: when the revision vendors third-party sources
criteria.acceptance_rule: Every vendored file carries the upstream license header.
criteria.expected_evidence: Inspection of each vendored file's first lines.

criteria.requirement: The artifact was not modified during evaluation
criteria.acceptance_rule: The artifact tree after evaluation matches the tree the evaluation started from.
criteria.expected_evidence: Pre- and post-evaluation tree digests, or a reasoned reading of what changed.

adapters_skipped.name: container-build
adapters_skipped.missing_input: container toolchain on the evaluation host

ambiguity.question: Does the rate limit apply per API key or per client address?
ambiguity.resolution: Read as per API key: the brief and the vendor documentation both state the limit per key.

routing.rationale: Service change with a supplied test suite and a cited external limit, so execution and source verification both ran; the container and benchmark adapters had no toolchain to run on.

observations.text: The request path enforces the limit per API key, matching the published documentation.
The evaluation host has no container toolchain, so the reproducibility and throughput checks could not run.

claims.text: The regression suite passes on this revision.
claims.notes: Re-run by the evaluator in a worktree checked out at this revision.

claims.text: Throughput improved to 610 requests per second.
claims.notes: No workload, tool, or log accompanies the number.

criteria.reasoning: The suite ran in a worktree checked out at this revision and exited zero with no failures reported. The conclusion covers the suite as supplied, not untested paths.
